notes.technical_fail: Any refusal by the model or a provider filter cut-off (plans/003-refusal-rule.md). Never rank a technical fail.
notes.v1_score: 25 x (priority - 1), gated on parse_ok and length ratio 0.8-1.2 (CHANGELOG v1.0). Comparable only within one benchmark_version.
notes.cost_vs_baseline: Production episode cost with this writer / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash episode ($0.161). Computed from est_usd_per_episode where the run gave that instead.
notes.on_length: Scripts that passed the length gate (screens: the whole gate, incl. parse and cut-off), as passed/total.
notes.aired_catalogue: Run kind aired-catalogue: deterministic measures only, medians per writer in extra (with *_iqr), len_ratio = median words/target, gate_pass_rate = TTS-format parse only. Different prompts per model; repetition is length-dependent (r = 0.28); era flags, not a ranking. Per-episode rows: results/aired-catalogue.json.
